lens_recommendations.summary: INV-006 delegates watermark-gating to assert_arc_temporal_alignment, which only checks temporal alignment and defaults sponsor_id to None (tenancy bypass). ARC could run/read pre-watermark.
Adding api/ + web/ to a uv-only repo risks a settings.validate() regression for the capture path, a silently-excluded api/ wheel package, and pre-commit guard collisions.
An open POST /sessions kwargs splat into create_session(**body) lets a client/model set site_id/sponsor_id or smuggle PII; tenancy must be server-injected and inputs allow-listed.
The M0 safety story rests on 'blocked/scaffolded = non-executable', but on a no-auth localhost box the only real control is the server returning 501/absent. Any client-side disable is bypassable.
INV-002 relies on grep for write-SQL, which misses COPY/ON CONFLICT/CTE writes. A read-only DB role makes write impossible structurally.
Agent/tool invariants live in the Next.js/AI-SDK layer with no pytest reach; the real trust boundary must be FastAPI, validating every argument regardless of which tool produced it.
